text_a: The invoice was paid last week, wasn't it?
text_b: The invoice was paid last week, right?

text_a: Ya enviaste el informe, ¿verdad?
text_b: Todavía no enviaste el informe, ¿verdad?
what_differs: The first assumes the report was sent; the second assumes it was not.

text_a: Você já assinou o contrato, não é?
text_b: Você já assinou o contrato, certo?

text_a: No vienes mañana, ¿no?
text_b: Vienes mañana, ¿no?
what_differs: The tag '¿no?' after a negative statement can confirm either coming or not coming, so readers disagree.

text_a: Open the valve slowly before starting the pump.
text_b: Open the valve gradually before starting the pump.

text_a: Aumente la dosis a partir del tercer día.
text_b: Reduzca la dosis a partir del tercer día.
what_differs: Increase versus reduce the dose.

text_a: O prazo de entrega é curto.
text_b: O prazo de entrega é longo.
what_differs: Short versus long delivery deadline.

text_a: The room is warm.
text_b: The room is hot.
what_differs: Near-synonyms on a gradable scale; whether they describe the same temperature depends on the reader.

text_a: The result is not good.
text_b: The result is bad.
what_differs: 'Not good' includes mediocre or neutral results; 'bad' is the negative extreme.

text_a: El contrato no es válido.
text_b: El contrato es inválido.

text_a: A porta não está aberta.
text_b: A porta está fechada.
what_differs: A door that is not open could be ajar; whether that counts as closed is disputed.

text_a: El café no está caliente.
text_b: El café está frío.
what_differs: Not hot allows lukewarm or warm; cold is a specific state.

text_a: You must not leave without signing.
text_b: You are not allowed to leave without signing.

text_a: No es obligatorio llevar casco.
text_b: Está prohibido llevar casco.
what_differs: Helmet optional versus helmet forbidden.

text_a: Não é proibido fotografar o local.
text_b: É permitido fotografar o local.

text_a: You may not skip the review.
text_b: You need not do the review.
what_differs: The review is mandatory in the first and optional in the second.

text_a: Not all the samples passed.
text_b: All the samples did not pass.
what_differs: The second has scope ambiguity: some failed versus none passed.

text_a: No todos los empleados recibieron el bono.
text_b: Ningún empleado recibió el bono.
what_differs: Some received it versus none received it.

text_a: Nem todos os alunos entregaram o trabalho.
text_b: Alguns alunos não entregaram o trabalho.

text_a: Todos los pagos fueron rechazados.
text_b: No todos los pagos fueron aprobados.
what_differs: All rejected versus at least one not approved; some may have been approved.

text_a: Do not start the engine unless the oil is full.
text_b: Start the engine only if the oil is full.

text_a: Se reembolsa salvo que el producto esté usado.
text_b: Se reembolsa solo si el producto está usado.
what_differs: Refund excluded when used versus refund only when used.

text_a: Exceto se chover, o evento será ao ar livre.
text_b: Se não chover, o evento será ao ar livre.

text_a: You'll get the discount only if you subscribe.
text_b: You'll get the discount if you subscribe.
what_differs: Strictly 'only if' excludes non-subscribers, but many readers take a plain 'if' as also meaning only then.

text_a: Traiga como mínimo tres referencias.
text_b: Traiga más de dos referencias.

text_a: Se admiten como máximo cinco personas.
text_b: Se admiten menos de cinco personas.
what_differs: Five people are allowed in the first but not in the second.

text_a: Leve no máximo dois volumes.
text_b: Não leve mais de dois volumes.

text_a: La sala admite como máximo 50 personas.
text_b: La sala admite menos de 50 personas.
what_differs: Exactly 50 people fit in the first but not in the second.

text_a: Entregue el formulario antes del viernes.
text_b: Entregue el formulario hasta el viernes.
what_differs: Whether delivery on Friday itself is allowed is unclear in both and readers disagree.

text_a: Submit it no later than Friday.
text_b: Submit it by Friday.

text_a: Não saia até terminar o relatório.
text_b: Saia depois de terminar o relatório.
what_differs: The first is only a prohibition until done; the second orders leaving once done.

text_a: Call the client before the meeting.
text_b: Call the client after the meeting.
what_differs: The call happens before versus after the meeting.

text_a: Todos menos Ana firmaron el acta.
text_b: Firmaron el acta todos excepto Ana.

text_a: Everyone except the interns attends the briefing.
text_b: Only the interns attend the briefing.
what_differs: Interns are excluded in the first and the only attendees in the second.

text_a: Todos, menos o João, receberam o convite.
text_b: Todos receberam o convite, inclusive o João.
what_differs: João did not receive the invitation in the first and did in the second.

text_a: Pueden entrar todos menos los menores de 12 años.
text_b: Pueden entrar los mayores de 12 años.
what_differs: Children of exactly 12 are admitted in the first but unclear in the second.

text_a: Hay que pagar la tarifa si se quiere acceder al sótano.
text_b: Quien no pague la tarifa no puede acceder al sótano.

text_a: The warehouse closes once the last truck has left.
text_b: After the final truck departs, the warehouse closes.

text_a: Ele só come carne aos domingos.
text_b: Ele come carne aos domingos.
what_differs: The first restricts meat to Sundays; the second does not exclude other days.

text_a: She told him she'd call if she was free.
text_b: She told him she'd call if he was free.
what_differs: The condition depends on her availability versus his availability.
